description: This file contains utility classes and functions for decoding various data types, images, videos, audio, and MATLAB files, used within the PyTorch data pipeline. It includes handlers for different data formats and a Decoder class to manage multiple handlers.

classes.name: ImageHandler
classes.description: Class for decoding image data into numpy arrays, torch tensors, or PIL images based on specified image specifications.

classes.name: MatHandler
classes.description: Class for loading MATLAB files using scipy.io.loadmat.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: Class for decoding key/data pairs using a list of handler functions, with support for stream handling and flexible key extraction.

methods.name: basichandlers
methods.description: Function to transform raw byte data into Python objects based on file extension.

methods.name: handle_extension
methods.description: Creates a handler function that applies a given decoding function to files with specified extensions.

methods.name: imagehandler
methods.description: Factory function that creates an ImageHandler instance for a given image specification.

methods.name: mathandler
methods.description: Factory function that creates a MatHandler instance with optional loadmat keyword arguments.

methods.name: extension_extract_fn
methods.description: Function to extract file extension from a pathname.

methods.name: videohandler
methods.description: Function to decode video files using torchvision.io.read_video, requiring torchvision.

methods.name: audiohandler
methods.description: Function to decode audio files using torchaudio.load, requiring torchaudio.
